policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This document is a compilation of public comments received in response to NIST's Request for Information (RFI) on the AI Risk Management Framework, submitted between July and September 2021. It does not itself constitute policy but aggregates stakeholder input used to inform framework development. No binding requirements, prohibited practices, or penalties are established by this document.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: This document is a compilation of public comments on NIST's AI Risk Management Framework RFI. The framing centers on managing AI risks to users and the public through a standardized framework, consistent with consumer/public safety governance. Secondary frames are evident from submitters including rights organizations (EPIC, Color of Change), catastrophic risk institutes (Future of Life, Global Catastrophic Risk Institute), and industry innovation groups.
